sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the appellants.

The appellants are land losers who have approached this Court U/s.74 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text:
Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. The appeal has been filed against the judgment dated 01.07.2024 passed in L.A. Reference Case No.280 of 2019 by the learned Presiding Officer, Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Authority, Cuttack.

entities.text: Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Authority, Cuttack
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The said L.A. Reference Case No.280 of 2019 arises out of L.A. Case No.13/2017 initiated by the Zone Officer-cum-L.A. Collector, Bahalda Zone.
The acquisition was pursuant to the notification issued by the Land Acquisition Officer i.e. Zone Officer-cum-L.A. Collector, Bahalda Zone, Subarnarekha Irrigation Project, Bahalda.
Though the reference was answered in favour of the present appellants enhancing the quantum of compensation, the appellants herein want further enhancement and hence the appeal.
3. The appeal has been filed after a reported delay of 201 days.
